g.text: F126.1 delete the old evals: one deleting step
take the project out of the test's list
red: the folder still holds it
remove the references, then the project
what still leans on it, if anything
run the tests of what was touched
the files, the message, red then green

text.tspan: Every deleting step runs the same way. A rule test that lists the projects is changed first and goes red because the project is
still there. Then the project is deleted with Rider's own tools, the build says what still leans on it, and the touched tests go
